SeeMore: Core Strategies for Mathematics

One inexpensive quantitative-reasoning course. It can fill a math or elective requirement where the receiving college accepts this exact certificate.

Research profile · confirm exact school and course acceptance

How the credit works

ACE recommends three lower-division semester hours in quantitative reasoning for the CSM certificate, through November 30, 2027.

Pace and learning format

Self-paced. Provider estimates 10–60+ study hours; the ACE exhibit allows up to 120 hours. Completion depends on mastery.

Costs to check

The CSM course costs $54 USD. Optional personal coaching costs an additional $115 USD.

Check the current checkout terms and the costs that apply to your actual course list. Membership time, assessments, materials, retakes, transcripts, and school fees may need separate attention.

Assessments and requirements

A mastery-based certificate is required. The ACE exhibit lists a minimum passing score of 100; quantitative reasoning is distinct from college algebra or statistics.

Before you commit

  • Choose the exact receiving school, degree, and catalog year.
  • Confirm this specific course, recommendation or transcript source—not only the provider’s name.
  • Ask which requirement the learning will satisfy and check duplicate-credit, grade, date, and source limits.
  • Keep a written school decision before paying for an outside course you need for graduation.
